youtube.baslik: Can two sounds cancel each other out? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In a classic experiment, an air-conduction tone and a bone-conduction tone of the same frequency were presented together. With level and phase adjusted, the tones canceled each other and the listener heard nothing, showing that both routes become the same stimulus in the cochlea.
